name: Hotel photography prices from photographers' own pages
description: 58 published hotel, inn and resort photography prices from 15 US photographers and studios in 9 states, read from each business's own page on 24 November 2026: packages, day and half-day rates and per-image licences, with the rooms or images included, time on site, usage rights, turnaround, the source URL and notes on comparability.
creator: October (october-ai.com)

changelog.change: First release: 58 published prices from 15 businesses, each read from the business's own page on 24 November 2026.
